from pathlib import Path
b=bytearray(Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-zstd.b2frame').read_bytes())

for off in range(0x50, min(len(b),0x70)):
    b[off]=0
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('wrote', len(b))
